title: Project ARMS
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Teenagers whose arms hold nano-machine implants find those arms can transform into grotesque super-weapons, and they are hunted by cybernetic assassins and telekinetic opponents from a secret organization that wants to bring about the next evolution of humankind (Viz blurb via AniList). A 22-volume shonen action series by Kyoichi Nanatsuki and Ryoji Minagawa that won the 1999 Shogakukan Manga Award; MangaUpdates lists human experiments, clones, cyborgs, orphans and blood and gore.
life_message: It suggests that people made into weapons can still choose who they are, and that friends should resist those who treat humans as experiments.
